title: Bucket of Ender Dragon
description: you can now scoop the Ender Dragon into a bucket
body:
This mod adds the ability to pick the Ender Dragon up in a bucket

having the dragon in the bucket allows the user to place the Ender Dragon anywhere, players can also put the item in a dispenser and set a trap for other players 

Capturing the Ender Dragon when you first go throught the End Portal will make the game think you killed it and then reopen the portal and spawn the egg
